resume: LOOM-8 turns the FM-1 into a pocket groovebox: eight instrument tracks on ten engines, a 64-step sequencer with step tricks and parameter locks, players (arp, strum, hold), scenes and a song.

commandes.role: Keyboard one octave down; on Steps, previous bar; in step entry, moves the cursor.
Keyboard one octave up; on Steps, next bar; in step entry, moves the cursor.
Character (the track's effect), then Sends, then FX I and FX II.
List of the page's settings and actions; in a question, yes.
Envelope, then Filter, then the filter envelope.
Engine, then Play and Play 2 depending on the track.
Mix, then Master EQ, Master color, Master out, LFO and Setup.
Opens Arrange, then Song. Held, acts as a shift (undo, redo, fine tempo, scenes). In a question, no.
Saves. Held with a white key, saves into a slot.
Players (arp, strum, hold). On Steps, with a cell held, opens its tricks.
Opens Steps; page 2: Bar. Held on Steps, the keys play the track.
Starts and stops; on Song, plays from the chosen slot.
Arms step entry when stopped; held during playback, records.
Next page of the button; in a list, moves.
Moves to the page's next item: preset, pattern, scene...

gestes: SEQ held on Steps: the keys play the track and set what a cell writes.
A button held for one second: a card explains its role.
